title: The etale projection mate has the normalized pro-etale counit transpose
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p
e\ell$; let $ ar X$ and $Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$ and $p: ar X	o Y$ a proper $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $A	o B$ be a homomorphism of finite commutative rings killed by powers of $\ell$. On the small étale and pro-étale sites use the ordinary uncompleted constant-ring module derived categories and the exact comparison pullbacks $
u_T^*$, with $
u_T^{-1}A_{T,\mathrm{et}}=A_T$ and $
u_T^{-1}B_{T,\mathrm{et}}=B_T$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]; on both sites use the derived adjunctions with counits $\varepsilon^{e}$ and $\varepsilon^{p}$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], and regard $B$ as an $A$-module. Let $K\in D^+( ar X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ be such that $H=K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A}B_{ ar X,\mathrm{et}}$ (étale derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]) also lies in $D^+( ar X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and put $N=
u_{ ar X}^*K$. Let $ eta_K:
u_Y^*Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}K\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_{*}N$ and $ eta_H:
u_Y^*Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}H\xrightarrow{\sim}Rp_*
u_{ ar X}^*H$ be the canonical normalized comparison isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-direct-image-canonical-mate] for $u=p$ and $\Lambda=A$, and identify $
u_{ ar X}^*H\simeq N\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A}B_{ ar X}$ and $
u_Y^*(Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_{Y,\mathrm{et}})\simeq
u_Y^*Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_Y$ by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Let
$$\pi_K:Rp_{\mathrm{et},*}K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_{Y,\mathrm{et}}\longrightarrow Rp_{\mathrm{et},*} igl(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_{ ar X,\mathrm{et}} igr)$$
be the étale projection morphism of [def-kun-projection-formula-map] (with $E=K$ and coefficient object $B_{Y,\mathrm{et}}$, $p^{-1}B_{Y,\mathrm{et}}=B_{ ar X,\mathrm{et}}$), and define the $A$-linear pro-étale map
$$t= eta_H\circ
u_Y^*(\pi_K)\circ( eta_K^{-1}\otimes^{\mathbf L}1):Rp_*N\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_Y\longrightarrow Rp_* igl(N\otimes^{\mathbf L}_AB_{ ar X} igr).$$
Then the adjoint transpose of $t$ under $p^*\dashv Rp_*$ on $A$-modules, composed with the tensor-pullback identification $p^*(Rp_*N\otimes^{\mathbf L}B_Y)\simeq p^*Rp_*N\otimes^{\mathbf L}B_{ ar X}$, is $\varepsilon^p_N\otimes^{\mathbf L}1_{B_{ ar X}}$. In particular $t$ is an isomorphism whenever $\pi_K$ is.

proof.text: Include fixedComparisonDirectImageMatePlus into the unbounded categories using the specified exact-functor and right-derived D+ compatibility isomorphisms. Include its recorded counit normalization, identify both included counits, and cancel the pullback comparison. Injectivity of adjoint transposition identifies spDirectImageComparisonIso.hom with BoundaryComparison.directImageMate at each bounded-below object K and H. The private sp_comparison_hom proves this directly from the recorded normalization.

Use the existing proved categorical projection-map square [lem-sp-categorical-projection-mate-square]. Its tensor compatibility for left-derived comparison pullbacks is the existing source theorem comparisonCompatible_leftDerivedComparisonUpperStarCompUpperStarIso. Transport this compatibility along the exact-versus-left-derived comparison isomorphisms (comparisonCompatible_transport). The transported square is BoundaryComparison.pullbackSquare, and tensorTransport_app identifies its tensor comparisons with the specified canonical fixed-coefficient comparison isomorphisms. Specialize at K and B_Y[0]. This gives the projection/exchange square with the actual specified maps, entirely within the ordinary fixed-ring sheaf categories.

Substitute the normalized comparison components at K and H. Precompose the square with the inverse tensor comparison and tensor of the inverse K-comparison, and cancel both isomorphisms. The resulting equality identifies spEtaleMate with the pro-etale right-derived projection map. Its existing adjoint-transpose formula and the inverse identity for the pullback tensor comparison give exactly the stated normalized transpose.

When the etale projection is invertible, every factor in the definition of spEtaleMate is invertible. Functors preserve isomorphisms and the other four factors are components or functorial images of specified isomorphisms. Their composite is invertible.

lean.statement: theorem spEtaleMate_transpose (ℓ p : ℕ) (_hℓ : ℓ.Prime) (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k p] (_hp : 0 < p) (_hne : p ≠ ℓ) {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B] (_hA : ∃ n : ℕ, (ℓ : A) ^ n = 0) (_hB : ∃ n : ℕ, (ℓ : B) ^ n = 0) (a : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] [IsProper f] (K : DerivedCategory (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A))) (hK : ∃ n : ℤ, K.IsGE n) (hH : ∃ n : ℤ, (spEtaleTensorObject a f K).IsGE n) : (leftDerivedUpperStarTensorIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).rightDerivedFunctor.obj ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)) ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj (spEtaleCoefficient a Y))).inv ≫ ((derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).homEquiv (spEtaleMateSource a f K) (spEtaleMateTarget a f K)).symm (spEtaleMate a f K hK hH) = ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).map ((derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).counit.app ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).mapDerivedCategory.obj K))).app ((upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) f).leftDerivedFunctor.obj ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).mapDerivedCategory.obj (spEtaleCoefficient a Y))) ∧ (IsIso (spEtaleProjection a f K) → IsIso (spEtaleMate a f K hK hH))
